priorityList: Summon your pet or use Grimoire of Sacrifice before combat begins.
Summon Infernal and use Malevolence on cooldown, ideally synchronized with each other.
Use offensive trinkets, racial abilities, and potions while Summon Infernal is active.
Cast Ruination immediately whenever it becomes available from your Diabolic Ritual.
Cast Cataclysm to apply Immolate to the entire pack (or to trigger Lake of Fire if talented).
Cast Rain of Fire as your primary Soul Shard spender when 4 or more enemies are present.
Apply Havoc to a secondary target that will survive at least 8 seconds, unless Summon Infernal is about to be cast.
Cast Chaos Bolt if there are 3 or fewer targets or to progress the Diabolic Ritual cycle.
Cast Soul Fire if you have fewer than 4 Soul Shards and there are 5 or fewer targets (up to 10 targets if Avatar of Destruction is talented).
Use Shadowburn on targets affected by Havoc or when Fiendish Cruelty is active.
Maintain Immolate manually on up to 5 targets if Cataclysm is on cooldown and the targets will live long enough.
Cast Conflagrate to generate Soul Shards and keep Backdraft from capping at 2 stacks.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have 3 or fewer Soul Shards.
Use Incinerate as your filler spell for soul shard generation.
